title: Lonely runner conjecture: dense windows and the covering framework, an obstruction catalogue, a perturbation bound, a reduction, and eight runners, with leave-one-out values of tight Goddyn-Wong vectors
description: Seven manuscripts on the lonely runner conjecture (dense velocity windows, obstructions to certificate-based proofs, perturbations of the tight instance, a reduction to a single crux, a covering framework, eight runners, and leave-one-out values of tight Goddyn-Wong vectors), the Lean 4 sources they cite, and the programs and certificates that regenerate their finite computations. Statements carry the labels given in each manuscript: VERIFIED means formalized in Lean 4 in the development repository, carried over to this archive without a rebuild; PROVED means a written proof not formalized; HEURISTIC means computation only; CONJECTURE means no proof. Several results are finite computations. The dense-window statement is not claimed for m = 94, 97, 103, 109, 115 and 122 (certificates for 97, 103, 109, 115 and 122 are accepted by an independent checker but no Lean module is built; m = 94 has no certificate). Counts without an archived generator are marked in CLAIMS.tsv. Several results are known or partly known (Beck-Everett, Zhang, Giri-Kravitz, Czerwinski, Bedert, Tao); attributions are given in the manuscripts. The computations are single-author and have not been independently reproduced. The leave-one-out note (version 1.0.4) has written proofs relative to two quoted results (Goddyn-Wong Theorem 2.3; Dusart bounds on the prime counting function) and exact computations for small cases; it is not formalized in Lean.
